title: 我們贏了一場欸
mood: losers for three seasons, champions for one night
subject: an office basketball team winning its first game in three seasons on two free throws from the accountant
caption: Taiwanese stadium band pop-rock in the Mayday and 831 arena style. Two overdriven electric guitars, one chugging eighth-note power chords and one ringing chorus-pedal arpeggios; a picked bass locked to the kick; a live drum kit with a big room-miked snare on two and four, crashes on every chorus downbeat and floor-tom rolls into the chorus; a piano doubling the chorus melody, with a string pad entering in the last chorus. Big and roomy with wide guitars, the lead vocal and the snare forward, the bridge dropping to half-time. Earnest bright male lead in the mid-high range, almost spoken in the verses and belting open vowels in the chorus, with a crowd-style gang vocal singing whoa-oh in the bridge. 148 BPM, E major. Office workers who just won one game and feel like champions. No synth bass, no programmed drums, no autotune, no rap verse, no screamed vocals.
lyrics:
[Intro - power-chord chug, ringing chorus guitar, floor-tom roll]

[Verse 1]
三個球季 我們一場都沒贏過
球衣是運動會剩下的 背號用膠帶貼
會計投籃之前 一定要先推一下眼鏡
替補的工程師 坐在板凳上回客戶的信

[Pre-Chorus]
剩四秒 我們輸一分
球不知道為什麼 傳到了會計手上

[Chorus]
我們贏了一場欸
罰球線上那個推眼鏡的人 兩球都進
沒有記者 沒有轉播 只有看門的伯伯在打瞌睡
可是我們抱成一團 好像拿了冠軍

[Verse 2]
對面是銀行隊 上禮拜還在笑我們
我們的啦啦隊 是會計的女兒跟她的平板
贏了也沒有獎盃 體育館的燈九點半準時關
我們在停車場 用寶特瓶乾杯

[Chorus]
我們贏了一場欸
罰球線上那個推眼鏡的人 兩球都進
明天開會一樣會被罵 報表一樣要交
可是今天晚上 我們是整個停車場最大聲的

[Bridge - half-time, gang vocals]
喔 喔喔 喔 我們贏了一場
喔 喔喔 喔 下禮拜再輸也沒關係

[Chorus - full band, string pad enters]
我們贏了一場欸
罰球線上那個推眼鏡的人 兩球都進
三個球季 才等到這一場
今天晚上 誰都不准先回家

[Outro - band stops on a held crash, spoken]
「下禮拜打誰？」「不管 先去吃鹹酥雞」
